innovation_summary: pro-code is the operator control surface of the APEX estate: a TypeScript human-facing coding and worker-mesh console for directing repository work while preserving operator authority and keeping execution visible rather than implicit. The catalog records it as a domain 'whole' (not a part) with the whole_note 'human control surface / worker mesh', and the function atlas names it the head of the Operator Surfaces function system. Its strongest external proof is cross-repository: the VERIFIED computer-user dossier records a pro-code-originated live receipt in which a call issued from pro-code produced a hash-bound action receipt carrying caller, capability, and the exact terminal/AKOS source SHA, independently verified by AKOS over HTTP. That makes the origination path — operator intent becoming an authority-bounded, provenance-carrying action — a verified path rather than a claim, even though pro-code's own repository-native gates are not yet published.
